name: Seoul Semiconductor Co., Ltd.
summary: Seoul Semiconductor Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells light emitting diodes (LEDs) products worldwide. The company offers high and mid power products; low power chip LEDs and through holes; chip on boards; filament LEDs; modules; nano and micro drivers; automotive products; backlighting units for TVs/monitors, notebooks/tablets/mobiles, and automotive display products; and flash LEDs, as well as sensor and datacom products. It provides its products for residential, commercial, horticulture, industrial, outdoor and entertainment, module and driver, front lightning, automotive, interior, sensor, datacom, bio identification, AR, VR, LiDAR, and CCTV applications.
